> <samp><kbd>CORE: ONLINE</kbd> // <b>DESIGNATED FAULT-LOGGING CHANNEL</b></samp>

Incomplete fault reports get reconstructed from guesswork. Nobody enjoys that, not even me.

**What died**

A clear, short description of the failure. One sentence. No incense.

**Reproduction sequence**

1. Opened…
2. Selected…
3. Watched…
4. Catastrophe: …

**Environment**

- Platform: <kbd>Windows 10/11 x64</kbd> or <kbd>Android X.Y</kbd> / device model
- App version: <kbd>vX.Y.Z</kbd> (see release tag)
- Content type: <kbd>Live TV</kbd> / <kbd>Tube</kbd> / <kbd>Vault</kbd> / <kbd>other</kbd>

**Evidence**

Logs, console output, or screenshots — if any were left on the scene.

```diff
- REMINDER: THIS PROJECT RECORDS NOTHING. YOUR LOG IS THE ONLY WITNESS.
```
